name: LAP Mentor

urls.caption: Surgical Science, LAP Mentor Product Page

description: The LAP Mentor (including LAP Mentor VR and LAP Mentor Express) is a multidisciplinary laparoscopic surgical simulator developed by Surgical Science (originally Simbionix). It features tactile haptic feedback mechanisms and realistic instrument handles that simulate tissue resistance, organ manipulation, and tactile feedback during laparoscopic procedures. Offering a library of VR modules ranging from basic laparoscopic skills and suturing to laparoscopic cholecystectomy, hernia repair, hysterectomy, and lobectomy procedures, LAP Mentor provides a training environment for surgical residents and teams.
